entry.title: MPC Template Chooser 1.0.1
entry.summary: Repackages MPC Template Chooser with Open MPC’s current installer and uninstaller. The package declares the Open MPC boot-reload service as an installation requirement. A current Open MPC add-in installer, such as MPC Remote’s, can supply the service on supported setups. This catalog release contains the ARMv7 build for the original MPC X. entry.title: MPC Template Chooser 1.0.0
entry.summary: # MPC Template Chooser 1.0.0 MPC Template Chooser replaces Demos on the standalone New Project screen with **Local templates**. Put .xpj projects in a folder named "Templates" at the root of a drive. Subfolders work too. This release targets the original MPC X with MPC OS 3.10.1 or later and the Open MPC boot-reload service.
